title: Choose the onboarding composition
question: The visual identity stays Audify: dark-first, editorial, artwork-aware, and native to Android. Which composition should carry the complete four-stage onboarding?

options.label: Moonlit listening lane
options.lineage: A moon-shadow bazaar translated into one clear vertical listening route
options.thesis: A calm, continuous path connects discovery, personal audio, and shared sessions.
options.viewport: The Audify mark leads a vertical lane of three capabilities; each stop reads as a real feature, not a decorative card.
options.risk: The metaphor must stay subtle; literal market imagery would distract from the music.

options.label: Signal field
options.lineage: A live scene rendered as typewriter characters
options.thesis: A compact signal field makes discovery, local playback, and shared listening feel connected.
options.viewport: A single signal trace leads into three precise capability labels; the rest of the flow keeps the same compact signal language.
options.risk: A monospace-first identity would conflict with Audify's established SF Pro typography and could look like a terminal costume.

options.label: Darkroom sequence
options.lineage: A printing darkroom under amber safelight
options.thesis: The setup unfolds as a deliberate develop sequence, with each choice visible before it is made.
options.viewport: A listening waveform is revealed through a restrained exposure strip, with the four onboarding stages shown as one clear process.
options.risk: A warm amber palette could pull the onboarding away from Audify's neutral dark identity if overused.
